translations.literal: The grades then established: those fully passing in text and law were upper grade, directly appointed reviewers;
translations.idiomatic: Grades were set as follows: full mastery of text and law ranked upper grade, with direct appointment as reviewer;

sentences.zh: 文法粗通者為次，與檢法；

translations.literal: those roughly passing in text and law were lower grade, granted legal examiner posts;
translations.idiomatic: rough mastery ranked lower grade, with appointment as legal examiner;

sentences.zh: 不通者駁放。

translations.literal: those not passing were rejected and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: failures were rejected outright.

sentences.zh: 度宗咸淳元年，申嚴選試之法，凡引試刑法官，命題一如《紹興式》。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianchun under Emperor Duzong, selection-examination regulations were tightened; for all who conducted penal examinations, question-setting followed the Shaoxing Form exactly.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianchun 1, Emperor Duzong tightened selection-exam rules: penal law examiners had to set questions strictly according to the Shaoxing Form.

sentences.zh: 八年，以試法科者少，特命考試命題，務在簡嚴，毋用長語。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because few took the legal examination, a special order required that examination questions be concise and strict, without long phrasing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, with few legal examinees, the court ordered exam questions to be concise and strict, without verbose phrasing.

sentences.zh: 有過而願試者，照見行條法，除私罪應徒、或入己贓、失入死罪並停替外，餘犯輕罪者，與放行收試。

translations.literal: Those with past offenses who wished to sit were handled according to current regulations: apart from private offenses warranting penal servitude, embezzlement, or erroneous imposition of capital punishment—all grounds for suspension—those guilty of lesser offenses were permitted to sit.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates with prior offenses who wished to sit were judged under current rules: private offenses warranting penal servitude, embezzlement, or erroneous capital sentences barred them; lesser offenses still allowed them to sit.

sentences.zh: 或已經三試終場之人，已曆三考，赴部參注，命本部考核元試，果有所批分數，不須舉狀，與注外郡刑法獄官差使一次，庶可激厲誘掖。

translations.literal: Or for those who had completed three full examination rounds, served through three evaluations, and came to the ministry for appointment, the ministry was ordered to verify their original examination marks; if marks were truly recorded, no recommendation memorial was needed, and they were granted one assignment as penal prison official in an outer prefecture, so that encouragement and guidance might be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had completed three full exam rounds and three evaluations and came to the ministry for appointment could have their original scores verified by the ministry; if scores were on record, no recommendation was needed—they received one assignment as penal prison official in an outer prefecture, as incentive and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 格法，試法科者，批及八分，方在取放之數。

translations.literal: By regulation, legal examinees scoring eight tenths or above were within the quota for selection and release.
translations.idiomatic: By regulation, legal examinees scoring eight tenths or higher qualified for selection.

sentences.zh: 咸淳末，有僅及二分以上者，亦特取一名，授提刑司檢法官，寬以勸之也。

translations.literal: At the end of Xianchun, even those scoring barely above two tenths were specially given one place, appointed legal examiners in the intendant’s office—a lenient measure to encourage them.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Xianchun, candidates scoring barely above two tenths were specially given one place as intendant’s-office legal examiners—a lenient measure to encourage participation.

sentences.zh: 初，宗學廢置無常。

translations.literal: At first, the Imperial Clan School was abolished and established without fixed rule.
translations.idiomatic: At first, the Imperial Clan School was repeatedly established and abolished without fixed practice.

sentences.zh: 凡諸王屬尊者，立小學於其宮。

translations.literal: For all imperial clansmen of honored rank, elementary schools were established in their palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Honored imperial clansmen maintained elementary schools in their palaces.

sentences.zh: 其子孫，自八歲至十四歲皆入學，日誦二十字。

translations.literal: Their descendants, from eight to fourteen years of age, all entered school, reciting twenty characters daily.
translations.idiomatic: Their descendants, aged eight to fourteen, all enrolled, reciting twenty characters daily.

sentences.zh: 其已授環衛官、有學藝得召試遷轉者每有之，然非有司常試，乃特恩也。

translations.literal: Some who had already received guard-office appointments and, through accomplishment in learning, were summoned for examination and transfer occurred from time to time, yet this was not a regular examination by the authorities—it was special grace.
translations.idiomatic: Some who held guard appointments and distinguished themselves in learning were occasionally summoned for special examinations and promotion—but these were not regular official exams, only special grace.

sentences.zh: 熙寧十年，始立《宗子試法》。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xining, the Examination Regulations for Imperial Clansmen was first established.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 10, the Examination Regulations for Imperial Clansmen was first promulgated.

sentences.zh: 凡祖宗袒免親已受命者，附鎖廳試；

translations.literal: All clansmen within the mourning-veil relationship who had already received appointments took the attached sealed-hall examination;
translations.idiomatic: Clansmen within the mourning-veil relationship who already held appointments took the attached sealed-hall examination;

sentences.zh: 自袒免以外，得試於國子監。

translations.literal: outside the mourning veil, they could examine at the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: those outside the mourning veil could examine at the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 禮部別異其卷而校之，十取其五，舉者雖多，解毋過五十人。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites separately distinguished their papers and graded them, taking five from ten; though many might pass, presentation was not to exceed fifty persons.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites graded their papers separately, selecting five from ten; however many passed, no more than fifty could be presented.

sentences.zh: 廷試亦不與進士同考。

translations.literal: The palace examination was also not conducted together with the presented scholars.
translations.idiomatic: The palace examination was held separately from the presented scholar examination.

sentences.zh: 年及四十、嘗累舉不中，疏其名以聞而錄用之。

translations.literal: Those reaching forty years of age who had repeatedly failed were listed by name, reported upward, and recorded for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Clansmen who reached forty after repeated failure had their names reported upward and were recorded for appointment.

sentences.zh: 其官於外而不願附各路鎖試，許謁告試國子監。

translations.literal: Those serving as officials outside who did not wish to take the attached sealed examination in each circuit were permitted to petition leave and examine at the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Officials serving in the provinces who declined the circuit sealed-hall exam could petition leave and examine at the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 崇寧初，疏屬年二十五，以經義、律義試禮部合格，分二等附進士榜，與三班奉職，文優者奏裁。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongning, distant clansmen at twenty-five years of age, passing the Ministry of Rites examination in classic principles and legal principles, were divided into two grades attached to the presented scholar list, granted Third Rank attendance, and those superior in letters were submitted for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chongning, distant clansmen at age twenty-five who passed the Ministry of Rites exam in classic and legal principles were ranked in two grades on the presented scholar list, granted Third Rank attendance, with superior literary merit submitted for imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 其不能試及試而黜者，讀律於禮部，推恩與三班借職，勿著為令。

translations.literal: Those unable to sit or failing the examination studied law at the Ministry of Rites and received grace appointment as Third Rank provisional office; this was not written into ordinance.
translations.idiomatic: Those unable or unwilling to sit, or who failed, studied law at the Ministry of Rites and received grace appointment as Third Rank provisional office—a practice not codified as permanent law.

sentences.zh: 及兩京皆置敦宗院，院皆置大、小學教授，立考選法，如《熙寧格》出官，所蒞長貳或監司有二人任之，乃注授。

translations.literal: When both capitals established Cherish the Clan Academies, each academy established elementary and advanced instructors, established examination and selection methods, and for leaving office according to the Xining Regulations, two chief or supervisory officials had to guarantee appointment before registration was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When both capitals established Cherish the Clan Academies, each appointed elementary and advanced instructors and examination rules. Under the Xining Regulations, appointment required guarantee by two supervising officials before registration.

sentences.zh: 後又許見在任者，於本任附貢士試。

translations.literal: Later, those currently in office were also permitted to take the attached presented-scholar examination in their current post.
translations.idiomatic: Later, incumbents were also allowed to take the attached presented-scholar exam in their current jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 大觀三年，宗子釋褐者十二人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daguan, twelve clansmen received initial appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In Daguan 3, twelve clansmen received initial appointment.

sentences.zh: 宗學官，須宗子中上舍第且有行者，方始為之。

translations.literal: Imperial Clan School officials had to be clansmen who ranked in the upper hall and possessed conduct before they could serve.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Clan School officials had to be upper-hall clansmen of proven conduct.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔：「宗子之升上舍，不經殿試，遽命之官，熙寧法不如是。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict said: "When clansmen advance to the upper hall without passing the palace examination and are immediately appointed to office, the Xining law was not like this.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, an edict declared: "Promoting clansmen to the upper hall and appointing them to office without a palace examination was not Xining practice.

sentences.zh: 其依貢士法，俟殿試補入上、中等者，唱名日取裁。」

translations.literal: Those following the presented-scholar method, awaiting palace examination to enter upper or middle grade, are decided on the day names are announced."
translations.idiomatic: Those under the presented-scholar method, awaiting palace examination for upper or middle grade, are decided on the day names are announced."

sentences.zh: 後又定上等賜上舍及第，中等賜出身，授官有差。

translations.literal: Later it was fixed that upper grade granted upper-hall passed status, middle grade granted presented-scholar status, with differentiated office appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Later upper grade was fixed as upper-hall passed status, middle grade as presented-scholar status, with differentiated appointments.

sentences.zh: 凡隸學，有篤疾若親老無兼侍者，大宗正察其實，罷歸。

translations.literal: For all enrolled in the school, those with serious illness or aged parents without another to attend them—the Director of the Imperial Clan verified the facts and dismissed them to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Enrolled clansmen with serious illness, or aged parents with no one else to care for them, were investigated by the Director of the Imperial Clan and dismissed to return home.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年，詔罷量試出官之法。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuanhe, an edict abolished the qualification-examination method for leaving office.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 2, an edict abolished the qualification-examination route to appointment.

sentences.zh: 紹興二年，帝初策士及宗子於集英殿。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxing, the emperor for the first time examined presented scholars and clansmen in the Hall of Assembled Excellence.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 2, the emperor first held palace examinations for presented scholars and imperial clansmen in the Hall of Assembled Excellence.

sentences.zh: 五年，初復南省試。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the provincial capital examination was first restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, the provincial capital examination was restored for the first time.

sentences.zh: 十四年，始建宗學於臨安，生員額百人：大學生五十人，小學生四十人，職事各五人。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, the Imperial Clan School was first established at Lin'an, with a student quota of one hundred: fifty advanced students, forty elementary students, and five each for administrative staff.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, the Imperial Clan School was first established at Lin'an with a quota of one hundred students: fifty in the advanced school, forty in the elementary school, and five administrative staff in each category.

sentences.zh: 置諸王宮大、小學教授一員。

translations.literal: One instructor each for the elementary and advanced schools of the princes' palaces was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: One instructor each was appointed for the elementary and advanced schools in the princes' palaces.

sentences.zh: 在學者皆南宮、北宅子孫，若親賢宅近屬，則別選館職教授。

translations.literal: All enrolled were descendants of the Southern and Northern Residences; for close relatives of the Close and Worthy Residence, palace-affiliated instructors were separately selected.
translations.idiomatic: Enrollees were all descendants of the Southern and Northern Residences; close relatives of the Close and Worthy Residence received separate palace instructors.

sentences.zh: 初，行在宗室試國子監者，有官鎖廳，七取其三；

translations.literal: At first, for imperial clansmen at the provisional capital examining at the Directorate of Education, those with office took the sealed-hall examination, three taken from seven;
translations.idiomatic: Initially, clansmen at the provisional capital who examined at the Directorate of Education and held office took the sealed-hall exam, with three selected from seven;

sentences.zh: 無官應舉，七取其四；

translations.literal: those without office who responded to the examination, four taken from seven;
translations.idiomatic: officeless examinees, four from seven;

sentences.zh: 無官袒免親取應，文理通為合格，不限其數；

translations.literal: officeless clansmen within the mourning veil taking the response-to-call examination—literary proficiency sufficed for qualification, with no limit on numbers;
translations.idiomatic: officeless clansmen within the mourning veil who took the response-to-call exam were qualified on literary grounds alone, without numerical limits;

sentences.zh: 而外任主宮觀、嶽廟試於轉運司者，取放之額同進士。

translations.literal: while those outside holding nominal posts at palace chapels and mountain temples, examining at the transport commission, had admission quotas equal to presented scholars.
translations.idiomatic: those serving nominal posts at palace chapels and mountain temples who examined through transport commissions had the same admission quotas as presented scholars.

sentences.zh: 十五年，命諸路宗室願赴行在試者，依熙寧舊制，並國子監請解；

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, clansmen in each circuit wishing to examine at the provisional capital were ordered to follow the old Xining system and submit credentials through the Directorate of Education;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, clansmen in each circuit who wished to examine at the provisional capital were ordered to follow Xining practice and submit credentials through the Directorate of Education;

sentences.zh: 不願者，依崇寧通用貢舉法，所以優國族也。

translations.literal: those unwilling followed the general presented-scholar law of Chongning—thus favoring the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: those who declined followed the general Chongning presented-scholar regulations—to favor the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 孝宗登極，凡宗子不以服屬遠近、人數多寡，其曾獲文解兩次者，並直赴廷試，略通文墨者，量試推恩。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaozong ascended the throne, for all clansmen regardless of degree of mourning relationship, distance, or numbers, those who had twice obtained literary qualification all went directly to the palace examination; those with slight literary competence received grace appointment through the qualification examination.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong ascended the throne, all clansmen—regardless of mourning relationship, proximity, or numbers—who had twice earned literary qualification went directly to the palace examination; those with modest literacy received grace appointment through the qualification exam.

sentences.zh: 習經人本經義二道，習賦人詩賦各一首，試論人論一首，仍限二十五歲以上，合格，第一名承節郎，餘並承信郎。

translations.literal: Classicists were tested on two questions in their classic; rhymed-prose students one each of poetry and fu; essay candidates one essay; still limited to twenty-five years and above; on passing, the first place received Chengjie Lang, the rest all Chengxin Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Classicists faced two questions on their classic; rhymed-prose students one poem and one fu; essay candidates one essay—all had to be twenty-five or older. The top candidate received Chengjie Lang; all others Chengxin Lang.

sentences.zh: 曾經下省人，免量試，推恩。

translations.literal: Those who had previously passed the lower provincial examination were exempt from the qualification examination and received grace appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had already passed the provincial examination were exempt from the qualification exam and received grace appointment.

sentences.zh: 四川則附試於安撫製置司。

translations.literal: In Sichuan, they were attached for examination at the Pacification and Military Affairs Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Sichuan, candidates were attached to the Pacification and Military Affairs Commission for examination.

sentences.zh: 於是入仕者驟逾千人。

translations.literal: Thereupon entrants to office suddenly exceeded one thousand persons.
translations.idiomatic: Entrants to office suddenly exceeded one thousand.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年，詔量試不中、年四十以上補承信郎，展三年出官，餘並於後舉再試。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing, an edict ordered that those failing the qualification examination and forty years of age or above be appointed Chengxin Lang, with leaving office deferred three years; the rest were all to re-examine at the next session.
translations.idiomatic: In Longxing 1, an edict ordered that qualification failures aged forty or above receive Chengxin Lang, with appointment deferred three years; all others were to re-examine at the next session.

sentences.zh: 四月，禦射殿引見取應省試第一人，賜同進士出身，第二、第三人補保義郎，餘四十人承節郎，七人承信郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, at the Imperial Archery Hall the first place in the response-to-call provincial examination was presented and granted status equal to presented scholar, the second and third appointed Baoyi Lang, forty others Chengjie Lang, seven Chengxin Lang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, at the Imperial Archery Hall the top candidate in the response-to-call provincial exam was presented and granted status equal to presented scholar; second and third were appointed Baoyi Lang; forty others Chengjie Lang; seven Chengxin Lang.

sentences.zh: 凡宗室鎖廳得出身者，京官進一秩，選人比類循資；

translations.literal: For all clansmen who obtained status through the sealed-hall examination, capital officials advanced one rank, selected men were promoted by analogous progression;
translations.idiomatic: Clansmen who gained status through the sealed-hall exam saw capital officials advance one rank and selected men promoted by analogous progression;

sentences.zh: 無官應舉得出身者，補修職郎；

translations.literal: those without office who obtained status through examination were appointed Associate for Meritorious Service;
translations.idiomatic: officeless examinees who gained status were appointed Associate for Meritorious Service;

sentences.zh: 濮、秀二王下子孫中進士舉者，更特轉一秩。

translations.literal: descendants of the two princes of Pu and Xiu who passed the presented scholar examination received an additional special promotion of one rank.
translations.idiomatic: descendants of the Princes of Pu and Xiu who passed the presented scholar exam received an additional special promotion of one rank.

sentences.zh: 乾道五年，命宗室職事隨侍子弟許赴國子監補。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Qiandao, clansmen who were administrative staff or attendant sons were permitted to enter the Directorate of Education as supplemental students.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao 5, clansmen serving as staff or attendant sons were permitted to enroll at the Directorate of Education as supplemental students.

sentences.zh: 六年，臣僚上言：「神宗朝，始立教養、選舉宗子之法。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, officials memorialized: "In the reign of Emperor Shenzong, methods for educating and selecting clansmen were first established.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, officials memorialized: "Under Emperor Shenzong, methods for educating and selecting clansmen were first established.

sentences.zh: 保義至秉義，鎖試則與京秩，在末科則升甲，取應不過量試注官，所以寵異同姓，不與寒畯等也。

translations.literal: From Baoyi to Bingyi, the sealed examination granted capital rank; in the last cohort rank was raised; response-to-call candidates only received appointment through the qualification examination—these favored the same surname and did not put them on par with humble scholars.
translations.idiomatic: From Baoyi to Bingyi, the sealed exam granted capital rank and last-cohort promotion; response-to-call candidates received only qualification-exam appointment—all to favor the imperial surname, not to equal humble scholars.

sentences.zh: 然曩時向學者少，比年雋異者多，或冠多士，或登詞科，幾與寒士齊驅；

translations.literal: Yet in former times few applied themselves to learning; in recent years many were outstanding, some heading the cohort of scholars, some entering the rhymed-prose category, nearly keeping pace with humble scholars;
translations.idiomatic: Yet formerly few studied diligently; recently many excelled—some topping the scholar cohort, some entering the rhymed-prose category—nearly matching humble scholars;

sentences.zh: 而入仕浸繁，未知裁抑，非所以示至公也。」

translations.literal: while entry to office grew ever more numerous, with no restraint in sight—this was not the way to display utmost fairness."
translations.idiomatic: yet entry to office grew ever more numerous without restraint—not the way to display utmost fairness."

sentences.zh: 於是禮部請鎖廳登第者，舊於元官上轉行兩官，自今止依元資改授，餘準舊制。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Ministry of Rites requested that for sealed-hall graduates, whereas formerly two ranks were transferred above their original office, from now on only reassignment at original qualification was permitted; the rest followed old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites proposed that sealed-hall graduates, formerly promoted two ranks above their original office, should hereafter receive only reassignment at original qualification; the rest followed old regulations.

sentences.zh: 十二年，右正言胡衛請：「自今宗室監試，無官應舉，照鎖廳例七取其二；

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Right Remonstrator Hu Wei requested: "From now on for imperial clan examinations, officeless examinees, following the sealed-hall precedent, two taken from seven;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Right Remonstrator Hu Wei requested: "Henceforth in imperial clan examinations, officeless candidates should follow the sealed-hall rule of two from seven;

sentences.zh: 省試則三舉所放人數如取應例，立為定額。」

translations.literal: for the provincial examination, the number admitted over three sessions should follow the response-to-call precedent, fixed as a permanent quota."
translations.idiomatic: and provincial exam admissions over three sessions should follow the response-to-call precedent as a fixed quota."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 寧宗嘉定四年，詔鎖廳應舉，省試第一名，殿試唱名授官日，於應得恩例外，更遷一秩。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiading under Emperor Ningzong, an edict ordered that for sealed-hall examinees, the first place in the provincial examination, on the day names were announced at the palace examination for office appointment, received one additional rank beyond the normal grace.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiading 4, an edict ordered that sealed-hall examinees who placed first in the provincial exam receive one additional rank beyond normal grace on the day names were announced at the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 九年，以宮學並歸宗庠，教授改為博士、宗諭。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the palace school was merged into the clan school; instructors were renamed Erudite and Clan Instructor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, the palace school was merged into the clan school; instructors became Erudites and Clan Instructors.

sentences.zh: 十四年，命前隸宮學近屬，令附宗學公、私試，中選者與正補宗學生，近屬子孫年十五以下者，許試小學生。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, former palace-school close relatives were ordered to take the public and private examinations of the clan school; those selected received regular enrollment as clan-school students; close relatives' descendants under fifteen were permitted to try for elementary students.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, former palace-school close relatives were ordered to take the clan school's public and private exams; successful candidates received regular enrollment; close relatives' descendants under fifteen could try for elementary school.

sentences.zh: 復置諸王宮大、小學教授一員。

translations.literal: One instructor each for the princes' palace elementary and advanced schools was again appointed.
translations.idiomatic: One instructor each was again appointed for the princes' palace elementary and advanced schools.

sentences.zh: 宗學解試依太學例取放，每舉附國子監發解所，異題別考。

translations.literal: The clan school's qualifying examination followed Imperial Academy precedent for admission; each session it was attached to the Directorate of Education's presentation office, with separate topics and separate grading.
translations.idiomatic: The clan school's qualifying exam followed Imperial Academy admission rules; each session it was attached to the Directorate's presentation office, with separate topics and grading.

sentences.zh: 理宗寶慶二年，以鎖廳宗子第一名若搢學深《春秋》，秀出譜籍，與補保義郎，特賜同進士出身，仍換修職郎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Baoqing under Emperor Lizong, for the first place among sealed-hall clansmen, Ru Jin mastered the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》, distinguished in lineage, was appointed Baoyi Lang, specially granted status equal to presented scholar, and still exchanged for Associate for Meritorious Service.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoqing 2, sealed-hall first-place clansman Ru Jin, who mastered the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》 and stood out in lineage, was appointed Baoyi Lang, specially granted status equal to presented scholar, and exchanged for Associate for Meritorious Service.

sentences.zh: 端平元年，命宗子鎖廳應舉解試，凡在外州軍，或寄居，或見任隨侍，及見寓行在就試者，各召知識官委保正身，國子監取其宗子出身、訓名、生長左驗，以憑保收試，仍於試卷家狀內具保官職位、姓名，以防欺詐。

translations.literal: In the first year of Duanping, clansmen taking the sealed-hall qualifying examination—whether in outside prefectures and armies, sojourning, currently serving as attendants, or residing at the provisional capital to examine—each summoned a knowing official to guarantee their identity; the Directorate of Education took clansmen's lineage credentials, courtesy names, and proof of upbringing for the guarantee to admit them; still on the household register within the examination paper, the guarantor's office and name were listed to prevent fraud.
translations.idiomatic: In Duanping 1, clansmen in the sealed-hall qualifying exam—whether in outside prefectures, sojourning, serving as attendants, or residing at the provisional capital—each required a knowing official to guarantee identity. The Directorate of Education verified lineage credentials, courtesy names, and upbringing before admission; guarantors' offices and names were recorded on household registers in the exam papers to prevent fraud.

sentences.zh: 淳祐二年，建內小學，置教授二員，選宗子就學。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunyou, an inner elementary school was established, two instructors appointed, and clansmen selected to study.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunyou 2, an inner elementary school was established with two instructors; clansmen were selected to enroll.

sentences.zh: 寶祐元年五月，特、正奏名進士宗子必光等二人特授保義郎，若瑰等二十九人承節郎，敕略曰：「必光等取應及選，咸補右階，蓋欲誘之進學，而教以入仕也。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Baoyou, two specially and regularly listed presented-scholar clansmen including Bi Guang were specially appointed Baoyi Lang; twenty-nine including Ruo Gui received Chengjie Lang. The edict in summary said: "Bi Guang and others, responding to the call and selected, were all appointed to the right ranks—intended to encourage them to advance in learning and to teach them entry to office.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoyou 1, fifth month, two specially and regularly listed presented-scholar clansmen including Bi Guang were specially appointed Baoyi Lang; twenty-nine including Ruo Gui received Chengjie Lang. The edict read in part: "Bi Guang and others, having responded to the call and been selected, were all appointed to the right ranks—to encourage advanced study and teach the path to office.

sentences.zh: 其毋以是自畫焉。」

translations.literal: Do not therefore limit yourselves thereby."
translations.idiomatic: Do not therefore limit yourselves by this."

sentences.zh: 度宗咸淳元年，以鎖廳應舉宗子兩請，舉人遇即位赦恩，並赴類試。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianchun under Emperor Duzong, as sealed-hall clansmen had twice petitioned, presented scholars encountering the accession amnesty were all sent to the category examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianchun 1, as sealed-hall clansmen had twice petitioned, presented scholars benefiting from the accession amnesty were all sent to the category examination.

sentences.zh: 其曾經覆試文理通者，照例升等；

translations.literal: those who had previously passed re-examination with literary competence were promoted in grade according to precedent;
translations.idiomatic: those who had passed re-examination with literary competence were promoted by precedent;

sentences.zh: 文理不通及未經覆試者則否；

translations.literal: those without literary competence or who had not undergone re-examination were not;
translations.idiomatic: those without literary competence or without re-examination were not;

sentences.zh: 第五等人特與免銓出官。

translations.literal: fifth-grade persons were specially granted exemption from registry selection for leaving office.
translations.idiomatic: fifth-grade candidates were specially exempted from registry selection for appointment.

sentences.zh: 九年，凡無官宗子應舉，初生則用乳名給據，既長則用訓名。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, for all officeless clansmen examining, at birth milk-names were used to issue credentials; when grown, courtesy names were used.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, officeless clansmen used milk-names on birth credentials and courtesy names once grown.

sentences.zh: 其赴諸路漕司之試，有一人前後用兩據、印二卷者。

translations.literal: For those taking examinations at circuit transport offices, some persons used two credentials before and after, sealing two examination rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Some who examined at circuit transport offices used two different credentials and sealed two exam rolls.

sentences.zh: 至是，命漕司並索乳名、訓名各項公據，方許收試，以杜奸弊。

translations.literal: At this point, transport offices were ordered to demand official credentials for both milk-name and courtesy name before admitting them to examination, to stop fraud.
translations.idiomatic: Transport offices were now ordered to demand official credentials for both milk-name and courtesy name before admitting candidates—to stop fraud.

sentences.zh: 武舉、武選。

translations.literal: Military Presented Examination and Military Selection.
translations.idiomatic: Military Presented Examination and Military Selection.

sentences.zh: 咸平時，令兩製、館閣詳定入官資序故事，而未及行。

translations.literal: In the Xianping era, drafters and academy fellows were ordered to review precedents on official qualification and rank sequence for entering office, but this was not yet carried out.
translations.idiomatic: During Xianping, drafters and academy fellows were ordered to review precedents on official qualification and rank sequence for appointment, but the order was never implemented.

sentences.zh: 仁宗時，法置武學，既而中輟。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Renzong, the Military Academy was lawfully established, then suspended midway.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Renzong, the Military Academy was established by law but soon suspended.

sentences.zh: 天聖八年，親試武舉十二人，先閱其騎射而試之，以策為去留，弓馬為高下。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiansheng, twelve military examinees were personally tested; first their mounted archery was reviewed and tested, essays decided retention or rejection, bow and horse decided rank high or low.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiansheng 8, twelve military examinees were personally tested; mounted archery was tested first, essays decided pass or fail, and bow and horse determined rank.

sentences.zh: 神宗熙寧五年，樞密請建武學於武成王廟，以尚書兵部郎中韓縝判學，內藏庫副使郭固同判，賜食本錢萬緡。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xining under Emperor Shenzong, the Bureau of Military Affairs requested establishing the Military Academy at the Temple of King Wucheng, with Han Zhen of the Bureau of Military Affairs of the Ministry of Works as director and Deputy Commissioner of the Inner Storehouse Guo Gu as associate director, granted maintenance funds of ten thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 5, the Bureau of Military Affairs requested establishing the Military Academy at the Temple of King Wucheng, with Han Zhen of the Ministry of Works Bureau of Military Affairs as director and Inner Storehouse Deputy Commissioner Guo Gu as associate director, granted ten thousand strings in maintenance funds.

sentences.zh: 生員以百人為額，選文武官知兵者為教授。

translations.literal: Student quota was fixed at one hundred; civil and military officials knowledgeable in warfare were selected as instructors.
translations.idiomatic: The student quota was fixed at one hundred; civil and military officials knowledgeable in warfare were selected as instructors.

sentences.zh: 使臣未參班與門蔭、草澤人召京官保任，人材弓馬應格，聽入學，習諸家兵法。

translations.literal: Palace agents not yet attending court audience, yin privilege beneficiaries, and commoners were summoned with capital officials guaranteeing them; if talent and bow and horse met standards, they were permitted to enter and study the military classics of various schools.
translations.idiomatic: Palace agents not yet attending court, yin beneficiaries, and commoners required capital-official guarantors; those meeting talent and archery standards were permitted to enroll and study various schools of military strategy.

sentences.zh: 教授纂次歷代用兵成敗、前世忠義之節足以訓者，講釋之。

translations.literal: Instructors compiled successive generations' military successes and failures and loyal righteousness from former ages sufficient for instruction, and lectured on them.
translations.idiomatic: Instructors compiled historical military successes and failures and exemplary loyalty from former ages and lectured on them.

sentences.zh: 願試陣隊者，量給兵伍。

translations.literal: Those wishing to test battle formations were granted troops as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Those wishing to drill in battle formations were given troops as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 在學三年，具藝業考試等第推恩，未及格者，逾年再試。

translations.literal: After three years in school, accomplishments were listed for graded examination and grace appointment; those not passing re-examined the following year.
translations.idiomatic: After three years, accomplishments were tested for graded grace appointment; failures re-examined the following year.

sentences.zh: 凡試中，三班使臣與三路巡檢、砦主，未有官人與經略司教隊、差使，三年無過，則升至大使臣，有兩省、待制或本路鈐轄以上三人保舉堪將領者，並兼諸衛將軍，外任回，歸環衛班。

translations.literal: All who passed were: Third Rank palace agents and circuit patrol inspectors and fort commanders; men without office and circuit-commission drill instructors and assignment envoys—after three years without fault they were promoted to Great Palace Agent; with three guarantors of Secretariat drafters, academicians, or circuit commanders and above certifying fitness for command, they all concurrently held General of the Guard posts; on returning from outside appointment, they rejoined the guard roster.
translations.idiomatic: Successful candidates included Third Rank palace agents, circuit patrol inspectors, and fort commanders, as well as officeless men and circuit-commission drill instructors. After three years without fault they were promoted to Great Palace Agent; with three guarantors among Secretariat drafters, academicians, or circuit commanders certifying command ability, they concurrently held Guard General posts; after outside service they rejoined the guard roster.

sentences.zh: 科場前一年，武臣路分都監、文官轉運判官以上各奏舉一人，聽免試入學。

translations.literal: The year before the examination cycle, military circuit chief controllers and civil transport vice commissioners and above each memorial-recommended one person, permitted exemption from examination for enrollment.
translations.idiomatic: The year before the exam cycle, military circuit chief controllers and civil transport vice commissioners and above each recommended one candidate for examination exemption and enrollment.

sentences.zh: 生員及應舉者不過二百人。

translations.literal: Enrolled students and examinees were not to exceed two hundred persons.
translations.idiomatic: Enrolled students and examinees were capped at two hundred.

sentences.zh: 春秋各一試，步射以一石三斗，馬射以八斗，矢五發中的；

translations.literal: Spring and autumn each one examination; foot archery at one stone three dou, mounted archery at eight dou, five arrows hitting the target;
translations.idiomatic: One exam each in spring and autumn; foot archery at one stone three dou, mounted archery at eight dou, five arrows on target;

sentences.zh: 或習武伎，副之策略，雖弓力不及，學業卓然：並為優等，補上舍生，毋過三十人。

translations.literal: or those skilled in martial arts, supplemented by strategy—even if bow strength fell short, if learning was outstanding: all counted as upper grade, supplemented as upper-hall students, not exceeding thirty persons.
translations.idiomatic: or those skilled in martial arts with strategic competence—even if bow strength fell short, outstanding learners—all ranked upper grade as upper-hall students, capped at thirty.

sentences.zh: 試馬射以六斗，步射以九斗，策一道，《孫》、《吳》、《六韜》義十道，五通補內舍生。

translations.literal: Mounted archery tested at six dou, foot archery at nine dou, one policy essay, ten questions on the principles of the 《Sun》, 《Wu》, and 《Six Secret Teachings》, five passed to supplement inner-hall students.
translations.idiomatic: Mounted archery at six dou, foot archery at nine dou, one policy essay, ten questions on the 《Sun》, 《Wu》, and 《Six Secret Teachings》—five correct answers qualified for inner-hall status.

sentences.zh: 馬步射、馬戰應格，對策精通、士行可稱者，上樞密院審察試用；

translations.literal: those meeting standards in mounted and foot archery and mounted combat, with policy answers mastered and conduct commendable, were submitted to the Bureau of Military Affairs for review and trial appointment;
translations.idiomatic: those meeting mounted and foot archery and mounted combat standards, with masterful policy answers and commendable conduct, were submitted to the Bureau of Military Affairs for review and trial appointment;

sentences.zh: 雖不應格而曉術數、知陣法、智略可用，或累試策優等，悉取旨補上舍；

translations.literal: though not meeting standards, if skilled in numerology, knowing battle formations, with usable stratagem, or repeatedly earning upper grades in policy essays, all were approved by imperial decision for upper-hall supplementation;
translations.idiomatic: though failing standards, those skilled in numerology and battle formations with usable stratagem, or repeatedly earning top policy grades, all received imperial approval for upper-hall status;

sentences.zh: 武藝、策略累居下等，復降外舍。

translations.literal: those repeatedly ranking lower in martial arts and strategy were demoted back to the outer hall.
translations.idiomatic: repeated low ranks in martial arts and strategy meant demotion to the outer hall.

sentences.zh: 先是，樞密院修《武舉試法》，不能答策者，答兵書墨義。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Bureau of Military Affairs compiled the Military Examination Regulations; those unable to answer policy essays answered written interpretation of military texts.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the Bureau of Military Affairs compiled the Military Examination Regulations; those unable to answer policy essays answered written interpretation of military texts.

sentences.zh: 王安石奏曰：「三路義勇藝入三等以上，皆有旨錄用，陛下又欲推府界保甲法於三路，則武力之人已多。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi memorialized: "In the three circuits, Righteous and Brave men whose arts reached third grade and above have all been ordered recorded for appointment; Your Majesty also wishes to extend the capital-district militia law to the three circuits—then men of martial force are already numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi memorialized: "In the three circuits, Righteous and Brave men whose martial arts reached third grade and above have all been ordered appointed; Your Majesty also wishes to extend the capital-district militia law to the three circuits—martial men are already plentiful.

sentences.zh: 近以學究一科，從誦書不曉理廢之，而武舉復試墨義，則亦學究之流，無補於事。

translations.literal: Recently the Classicist category was abolished for reciting books without understanding principle, yet the military examination again tests written interpretation—then it is also of the Classicist type, of no help to affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Classicist category was recently abolished for rote recitation without understanding, yet the military exam again tests written interpretation—making it another rote category, useless in practice.

sentences.zh: 先王收勇力之士，皆屬於車右者，欲以備禦侮之用，則記誦何所施？」

translations.literal: The former kings gathered men of courage and strength, all assigned to the right of the chariot, intending them for defense against insult—of what use is memorization?"
translations.idiomatic: Former kings gathered brave men to the chariot's right for defense against insult—what use is memorization?"

sentences.zh: 於是悉從中書所定。

translations.literal: Thereupon all followed what the Secretariat had fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The court adopted the Secretariat's regulations in full.

sentences.zh: 凡武舉，始試義、策於秘閣，武藝則試於殿前司，及殿試，則又試騎射及策於庭。

translations.literal: For all military examinations, principles and policy essays were first tested at the Secret Archive; martial arts were tested at the Palace Front Office; at the palace examination, mounted archery and policy essays were again tested in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Military examinees first faced principles and policy essays at the Secret Archive and martial arts at the Palace Front Office; at the palace examination, mounted archery and policy essays were tested again in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 策、武藝俱優為右班殿直，武藝次優為三班奉職，又次借職，末等三班差使、減磨勘年。

translations.literal: Those superior in both policy and martial arts became Right Rank Attendance; next in martial arts became Third Rank Attendance; next provisional office; lowest grade Third Rank assignment envoys with reduced merit-review years.
translations.idiomatic: Top ranks in both policy and martial arts received Right Rank Attendance; next in martial arts, Third Rank Attendance; then provisional office; lowest grade, Third Rank assignment with reduced merit-review years.

sentences.zh: 策入平等而武藝優者除奉職，次優借職，又次三班差使、減磨勘年，武藝末等者三班差使。

translations.literal: Those equal in policy but superior in martial arts received Attendance; next provisional office; next Third Rank assignment with reduced merit-review years; lowest in martial arts, Third Rank assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Equal policy but superior martial arts earned Attendance; next, provisional office; then Third Rank assignment with reduced merit-review years; lowest martial arts, Third Rank assignment only.

sentences.zh: 八年，詔武舉與文舉進士，同時鎖試於貢院，以防進士之被黜而改習者，遂罷秘閣試。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, an edict ordered military and literary presented scholars to be sealed and examined simultaneously at the examination compound, to prevent presented scholars failing and switching to military study; the Secret Archive examination was then abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, an edict ordered military and literary presented scholars to be sealed and examined together at the examination compound, to prevent failed literary candidates from switching to military study; the Secret Archive exam was abolished.

sentences.zh: 又以《六韜》本非全書，止以《孫》、《吳》書為題。

translations.literal: Because the 《Six Secret Teachings》 was not a complete book, only the texts of the 《Sun》 and 《Wu》 were used as topics.
translations.idiomatic: Because the 《Six Secret Teachings》 was incomplete, only the 《Sun》 and 《Wu》 texts were used as exam topics.

sentences.zh: 元豐元年，立《大小使臣試弓馬藝業出官法》：第一等，步射一石，矢十發三中，馬射七斗，馬上武藝五種，《孫》、《吳》義十通七，時務邊防策五道文理優長，律令義十通七，中五事以上免短使、減一任監當，三事以上免短使、升半年名次，兩事升半年，一事升一季；

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanfeng, the Regulations on Bow, Horse, and Martial Arts for Testing Metropolitan and Outer Subordinates for Leaving Office was established: first grade-foot archery one stone, ten arrows three hits, mounted archery seven dou, five mounted martial arts, seven of ten on the principles of the 《Sun》 and 《Wu》, five current-affairs and frontier-defense policy essays of superior literary quality, seven of ten on legal principles; meeting five or more items exempted short assignments and reduced one term of supervisory duty; three or more exempted short assignments and advanced half a year in rank; two advanced half a year; one advanced one season;
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 1, the Regulations on Bow, Horse, and Martial Arts for Testing Metropolitan and Outer Subordinates for Leaving Office was promulgated. First grade: foot archery one stone with three of ten hits, mounted archery seven dou, five mounted martial arts, seven of ten on the 《Sun》 and 《Wu》, five superior frontier policy essays, seven of ten on legal principles. Five or more items met exempted short assignments and one term of supervisory duty; three or more exempted short assignments and advanced half a year; two advanced half a year; one advanced one season;

sentences.zh: 第二等，步射八斗，矢十發二中，馬射六斗，馬上武藝三種，《孫》、《吳》義十通五，策三道成文理，律令義十通五，中五事免短使、升半年，三事升半年，兩事升一季，一事與出官；

translations.literal: second grade—foot archery eight dou, ten arrows two hits, mounted archery six dou, three mounted martial arts, five of ten on the principles of the 《Sun》 and 《Wu》, three policy essays of coherent literary quality, five of ten on legal principles; five items met exempted short assignments and advanced half a year; three advanced half a year; two advanced one season; one granted leaving office;
translations.idiomatic: Second grade: foot archery eight dou with two of ten hits, mounted archery six dou, three mounted martial arts, five of ten on the 《Sun》 and 《Wu》, three coherent policy essays, five of ten on legal principles. Five items met exempted short assignments and advanced half a year; three advanced half a year; two advanced one season; one granted appointment;

sentences.zh: 第三等，步射六斗，矢十發一中，馬射五斗，馬上武藝兩種，《孫》、《吳》義十通三，策三道成文理，律令義十通三，計算錢穀文書五通三，中五事升半年，三事升一季，兩事與出官。

translations.literal: third grade—foot archery six dou, ten arrows one hit, mounted archery five dou, two mounted martial arts, three of ten on the principles of the 《Sun》 and 《Wu》, three policy essays of coherent literary quality, three of ten on legal principles, three of five on calculation, revenue, and document work; five items met advanced half a year; three advanced one season; two granted leaving office.
translations.idiomatic: Third grade: foot archery six dou with one of ten hits, mounted archery five dou, two mounted martial arts, three of ten on the 《Sun》 and 《Wu》, three coherent policy essays, three of ten on legal principles, three of five on calculation and document work. Five items met advanced half a year; three advanced one season; two granted appointment.

sentences.zh: 其步射並發兩矢，馬射發三矢，皆著為格。

translations.literal: Foot archery used two arrows per round, mounted archery three arrows—all fixed as standards.
translations.idiomatic: Foot archery used two arrows per round and mounted archery three—all codified as standards.

sentences.zh: 四年，罷試律義。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, testing of legal principles was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, legal-principles testing was abolished.

sentences.zh: 七年，止試《孫》、《吳》書大義一場，第一等取四通、次二等三通、三等二通為中格。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, only one session on the general principles of the 《Sun》 and 《Wu》 texts was tested; first grade required four passed, second three, third two as passing standards.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, only one session on the general principles of the 《Sun》 and 《Wu》 was tested; first grade required four correct, second three, third two.

sentences.zh: 元祐四年，詔解試、省試增策一道。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanyou, an edict ordered one additional policy essay in the qualifying and provincial examinations.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanyou 4, an edict added one policy essay to the qualifying and provincial examinations.

sentences.zh: 崇寧間，諸州置武學。

translations.literal: During the Chongning period, military academies were established in the prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: During Chongning, military academies were established in the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 立《考選升貢法》，仿儒學製，其武藝絕倫、文又優特者，用文士上舍上等法，歲貢釋褐；

translations.literal: The cited text was established, modeled on the Confucian system; those of peerless martial arts and exceptionally superior letters used the upper-hall upper-grade method for literary men, yearly presentation for initial appointment;
translations.idiomatic: The cited text was established, modeled on the Confucian system; those of peerless martial arts and exceptional literary merit used the literary upper-hall upper-grade method for yearly presentation and initial appointment;

sentences.zh: 中等仍隸學俟殿試。

translations.literal: middle grade remained enrolled awaiting the palace examination.
translations.idiomatic: middle grade remained enrolled awaiting the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 凡試出官使臣，仍赴殿前司呈試。

translations.literal: All palace agents tested for leaving office still presented themselves for examination at the Palace Front Office.
translations.idiomatic: All palace agents tested for appointment still presented themselves at the Palace Front Office.

sentences.zh: 諸州武士試補，不得文士同一場。

translations.literal: Prefectural military candidates for supplemental enrollment could not share a session with literary men.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural military supplemental candidates could not share an exam session with literary candidates.

sentences.zh: 馬射三上垛，九斗為五分，八斗為四分，七斗為三分。

translations.literal: Mounted archery with three upper-butt hits: nine dou counted as five parts, eight dou as four parts, seven dou as three parts.
translations.idiomatic: Mounted archery with three upper-butt hits: nine dou scored five parts, eight dou four parts, seven dou three parts.

sentences.zh: 九斗、八斗、七斗再上垛及一上垛，視此為差，理為分數。

translations.literal: Nine dou, eight dou, and seven dou with additional upper-butt hits and one upper-butt hit were graded by this difference and calculated as points.
translations.idiomatic: Additional upper-butt hits at nine, eight, or seven dou, and single upper-butt hits, were graded by this scale and calculated as points.

sentences.zh: 馬射一中帖當兩上垛，一中的當兩中帖。

translations.literal: One center-plate hit in mounted archery counted as two upper-butt hits; one bullseye counted as two center-plate hits.
translations.idiomatic: One center-plate hit in mounted archery counted as two upper-butt hits; one bullseye counted as two center-plate hits.

sentences.zh: 舊制，武舉三年一試，命官不過三十餘人，後增額，以每貢者三人即取一以升上舍，積迭增展，遂至百人入流，比文額太優。

translations.literal: Under the old system, the military examination was held every three years, with office appointments not exceeding thirty-odd persons; later quotas were increased, taking one from every three presented to advance to the upper hall; accumulation and expansion reached one hundred entering the ranks—far more favorable than the literary quota.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, the military exam was triennial, appointing no more than thirty-odd men; later quotas rose, promoting one of every three presented to the upper hall until one hundred entered the ranks—far more generous than the literary quota.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔自今貢試上舍者，取十人入上等，四十人入中等，五十人入下等，皆補充武學內舍，人材不足聽闕之，餘不入等者，處之外舍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict ordered that from now on for upper-hall presentation examinations, ten entered upper grade, forty middle grade, fifty lower grade—all supplemented as inner hall of the Military Academy; if talent was insufficient vacancies were permitted; the rest not graded were placed in the outer hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, an edict ordered upper-hall presentation exams to rank ten upper grade, forty middle, fifty lower—all as Military Academy inner hall, with vacancies if talent was insufficient; ungraded candidates went to the outer hall.

sentences.zh: 大抵以弓馬程文兩上一上、兩中一中、兩下一下相參以為第。

translations.literal: Generally, bow and horse with policy essays—two upper and one upper, two middle and one middle, two lower and one lower—were cross-referenced to determine grade.
translations.idiomatic: Grades were generally determined by cross-referencing bow, horse, and policy essays—two upper plus one upper, two middle plus one middle, two lower plus one lower.

sentences.zh: 凡州教諭，須州都監乃得兼，吏部取武舉、武士上舍出身者。

translations.literal: For all prefectural instructors, only the prefectural chief controller could concurrently serve; the Ministry of Personnel selected those from military examination and military upper-hall backgrounds.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural instructors could be held only by the prefectural chief controller; the Ministry of Personnel selected candidates from military examination and military upper-hall backgrounds.

sentences.zh: 政和三年，以隸學者眾，凡經三歲校試而不得一與者，除其籍。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenghe, as enrolled students were numerous, all who after three years of school examinations received not one award had their registry removed.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenghe 3, as enrollment swelled, students who won no award in three years of school examinations were struck from the registry.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年，尚書省言：「州縣武學既罷，有願隸京城武學者，請用元豐法補試。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuanhe, the Secretariat of the Department of State Affairs said: "Since prefectural and county military academies have been abolished, those wishing to enroll in the capital military academy request use of the Yuanfeng supplemental examination method.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 2, the Secretariat reported: "Since prefectural military academies have been abolished, those wishing to enroll in the capital Military Academy request the Yuanfeng supplemental examination method.

sentences.zh: 舊制，不入學而從保舉以試者，附試武學外舍，通取一百人。

translations.literal: Under the old system, those not enrolled but testing through guarantor recommendation were attached to the outer hall of the Military Academy, with one hundred taken in all.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, unenrolled candidates testing through guarantor recommendation were attached to the Military Academy outer hall, with one hundred admitted in all.

sentences.zh: 偕上舍生發解。

translations.literal: They presented credentials together with upper-hall students.
translations.idiomatic: They presented credentials together with upper-hall students.

sentences.zh: 今既罷科舉，請依元豐法奏舉，歲終集闕下，免試補外舍生，赴次年公試。

translations.literal: Now that the civil service examination has been abolished, it is requested to follow the Yuanfeng method of memorial recommendation; at year's end gather at the capital, be exempt from examination to supplement as outer-hall students, and proceed to the next year's public examination.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the civil service examination has been abolished, they requested the Yuanfeng memorial-recommendation method: candidates would gather at the capital at year's end, enter the outer hall without a qualifying exam, and sit the public examination the following year.

sentences.zh: 其春選升補推恩，依大觀法。」

translations.literal: Spring selection promotions and grace grants shall follow the Daguan method."
translations.idiomatic: Spring selection promotions and grace grants shall follow the Daguan method."

sentences.zh: 靖康元年，詔諸路有習武藝、知兵書者，州長貳以禮遣送詣闕，毋限數，將親策而用之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingkang, an edict ordered that in all circuits those skilled in martial arts and versed in military texts were to be ceremoniously escorted to court by the prefect and vice-prefect, with no limit on numbers; the emperor would personally examine them by policy questions and employ them.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingkang 1, an edict ordered all circuits to ceremoniously send to court anyone skilled in martial arts and versed in military texts, with no limit on numbers; the emperor would personally examine them and appoint them.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，詔武舉人先經兵部驗視弓馬於殿前司，仍權就淮南轉運司別場附試《七書》義五道，兵機策二首。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan, an edict ordered that military examination candidates first undergo Ministry of War inspection of bow and horse at the Palace Command, and provisionally at a separate venue of the Huainan Transport Commission take five questions on the meaning of the Seven Military Classics and two essays on military strategy.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyan 3, military examinees were first inspected in bow and horse by the Ministry of War at the Palace Command, then provisionally tested at a separate Huainan Transport venue on five Seven Military Classics questions and two military-strategy essays.

sentences.zh: 紹興五年，帝御集英殿策武舉進士，翌日閱試騎射，策入優等與保義、承節郎，平等承信郎，其武藝不合格者，與進義校尉。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shaoxing, the emperor held a policy examination for military jinshi at Jiying Hall; the next day he reviewed mounted archery. Those whose policy answers ranked upper grade received Baoyi Lang and Chengjie Lang; middle grade received Chengxin Lang; those whose martial arts failed received Jinyi Xiaowei.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 5, the emperor examined military jinshi by policy essay at Jiying Hall and reviewed mounted archery the next day. Top policy grades received Baoyi and Chengjie Lang; middle grade Chengxin Lang; those failing martial arts received Jinyi Xiaowei.

sentences.zh: 川、陝宣撫司類省試武藝合格人並補官。

translations.literal: Those who passed martial arts in the provincial-style examination of the Sichuan-Shaanxi Pacification Commission were all granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Martial-arts qualifiers from the Sichuan-Shaanxi Pacification Commission's provincial-style exam were all appointed to office.

sentences.zh: 十二年，禦試，正奏名，策入優等承節郎，平等承信郎、進義校尉；

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, at the imperial examination, for regular presented names, upper policy grade received Chengjie Lang, middle grade Chengxin Lang and Jinyi Xiaowei;
translations.idiomatic: In year 12, at the imperial exam, regular presented names with top policy grades received Chengjie Lang; middle grades Chengxin Lang or Jinyi Xiaowei;

sentences.zh: 特奏名，平等進義校尉，各展磨勘有差。

translations.literal: for special presented names, middle grade received Jinyi Xiaowei, each with varying extensions of merit review.
translations.idiomatic: special presented names at middle grade received Jinyi Xiaowei, each with differing merit-review extensions.

sentences.zh: 十六年，始建武學。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, the Military Academy was first established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16, the Military Academy was first established.

sentences.zh: 兵部上《武士弓馬及選試去留格》，凡初補入學，步射弓一石，若公、私試步騎射不中，即不許試程文，其射格自一石五斗以下至九斗，凡五等。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War submitted the Regulations on Warrior Bow and Horse and Selection Examination Retention and Dismissal. For initial supplementation into enrollment, foot archery required a one-shi bow; if public or private foot or mounted archery failed, policy essays were not permitted. Bow grades ranged from one shi five dou down to nine dou—five grades in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War submitted regulations on warrior bow and horse and selection-exam retention. Initial entrants shot foot archery with a one-shi bow; failure in public or private foot or mounted archery barred policy essays. Bow grades ran from one shi five dou down to nine dou in five tiers.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，帝見武學頹弊，因諭輔臣曰：「文武一道也，今太學就緒，而武學幾廢，恐有遺才。」

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, the emperor saw the Military Academy in decline and therefore instructed the chief ministers: "Civil and military are one path. Now the Imperial Academy is in order, but the Military Academy is nearly abandoned—I fear talented men are being lost."
translations.idiomatic: In year 26, seeing the Military Academy in decline, the emperor told his chief ministers: "Civil and military are one path. The Imperial Academy is now in order, but the Military Academy is nearly defunct—I fear we are losing talent."

sentences.zh: 詔兵部討論典故，參立新製。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Ministry of War to investigate precedents and establish new regulations.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Ministry of War to investigate precedents and draft new regulations.

sentences.zh: 凡武學生習《七書》兵法、步騎射，分上、內、外三舍，學生額百人，置博士一員，以文臣有出身或武舉高選人為之；

translations.literal: All Military Academy students studied the tactics of the Seven Military Classics and foot and mounted archery, divided into upper, inner, and outer halls, with a quota of one hundred students. One Erudite was appointed from civil officials with examination backgrounds or top military examination selectees;
translations.idiomatic: Military Academy students studied Seven Military Classics tactics and foot and mounted archery, divided into upper, inner, and outer halls with a quota of one hundred. One Erudite was drawn from civil officials with examination backgrounds or top military examinees;

sentences.zh: 學諭一員，以武舉補官人為之。

translations.literal: one Instructor was appointed from persons appointed through the military examination.
translations.idiomatic: one Instructor from military-examination appointees.

sentences.zh: 凡補外舍，先類聚五人以上附私試，先試步射一石弓，不合格不得試程文，中格者依文士例試《七書》義一道。

translations.literal: For supplementation to the outer hall, five or more were first grouped for attached private examination; foot archery with a one-shi bow was tested first—failure barred policy essays; passers took one question on the meaning of the Seven Military Classics per the literary student precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Outer-hall supplementation required groups of five or more for attached private exams: foot archery with a one-shi bow first, with failure barring policy essays; passers then took one Seven Military Classics question under the literary-student rule.

sentences.zh: 其內舍生私試，程文三在優等，弓馬兩在次優，公試入等，具名奏補。

translations.literal: For inner-hall private examinations, three upper grades in policy essays and two next-to-upper in bow and horse, with public examination graded, names were submitted for supplementation.
translations.idiomatic: Inner-hall private exams required three top policy grades and two near-top bow-and-horse grades plus a passing public exam before names were submitted for promotion.

sentences.zh: 試上舍者，以就試人三取其一，以十分為率，上等一分，中等二分，下等七分，仍以三年與發解同試。

translations.literal: For upper-hall examination, one of three candidates was taken; on a ten-part ratio, upper grade one part, middle two parts, lower seven parts; still tested together with credential presentation every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Upper-hall exams took one of three candidates on a ten-part scale—one upper, two middle, seven lower—and still ran on the three-year cycle with credential presentation.

sentences.zh: 凡內舍補上舍，以上舍試合格入等與行藝相參，兩上者為上等，一上一中或兩中及一上一下為中等，一中一下或兩下、一上一否為下等，仍不犯第三等罰、士行可稱者，具名奏補。

translations.literal: For inner hall supplementing upper hall, upper-hall examination grades cross-referenced with conduct: two upper grades counted as upper; one upper and one middle, two middle, or one upper and one lower counted as middle; one middle and one lower, two lower, or one upper and one fail counted as lower; without third-grade penalty and with commendable conduct, names were submitted for supplementation.
translations.idiomatic: Inner-to-upper promotion cross-referenced upper-hall grades with conduct: two uppers ranked upper; one upper plus one middle, two middles, or one upper plus one lower ranked middle; one middle plus one lower, two lowers, or one upper plus one fail ranked lower—provided there was no third-grade penalty and conduct was commendable.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，禦試第一名趙應熊武藝絕倫，又省試第一，特與保義郎、閣門祗候。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, at the imperial examination the first-place candidate Zhao Yingxiong had unmatched martial arts and was also first in the provincial examination; he was specially granted Baoyi Lang and Gate Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27, imperial exam first place Zhao Yingxiong had unmatched martial arts and had also topped the provincial exam; he was specially granted Baoyi Lang and Gate Attendant.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，修立武舉入官資格；

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, qualifications for military examination office entry were established;
translations.idiomatic: In year 29, military-examination office-entry qualifications were codified;

sentences.zh: 命武舉人自今依府監年數免解。

translations.literal: military examination candidates were ordered from now on to be exempt from credential presentation according to the prefectural and supervisory year count.
translations.idiomatic: military examinees were henceforth exempt from credential presentation under the prefectural and supervisory year rule.

sentences.zh: 孝宗隆興元年禦試，得正奏名三十七人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing under Emperor Xiaozong, at the imperial examination, thirty-seven regular presented names were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: In Longxing 1, at Emperor Xiaozong's imperial examination, thirty-seven regular presented names were announced.

sentences.zh: 殿中侍御史胡沂言：「唐郭子儀以武舉異等，初補右衛長史，曆振遠、橫塞、天德軍使。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Censor Hu Yi said: "In Tang, Guo Ziyi passed the military examination with exceptional grade and was first appointed Right Guard Chief Clerk, then served successively as commissioner of the Zhenyuan, Hengsai, and Tiande armies.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Censor Hu Yi said: "In Tang, Guo Ziyi passed the military examination with exceptional distinction, was first appointed Right Guard Chief Clerk, and then served successively as commissioner of the Zhenyuan, Hengsai, and Tiande armies.

sentences.zh: 國初，試中武藝人並赴陝西任使。

translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty, those who passed martial arts examinations were all sent to Shaanxi for assignment.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the dynasty, martial examination qualifiers were all sent to Shaanxi for assignment.

sentences.zh: 又武舉中選者，或除京東捉賊，或三路沿邊，試其效用，或經略司教押軍隊、準備差使，今率授以榷酤之事，是所取非所用，所用非所學也。

translations.literal: Again, those selected in the military examination were sometimes appointed as bandit-suppression commissioners in Jingdong, sometimes posted along the three frontier circuits to test their effectiveness, or assigned by Pacification Commissions to train and command troops or serve as reserve dispatch officers; now they are uniformly given liquor-monopoly duties—what was selected is not what is used, and what is used is not what was studied.
translations.idiomatic: Again, military examination qualifiers were sometimes appointed as Jingdong bandit-suppression commissioners, sometimes posted along the three frontier circuits to test their usefulness, or assigned by Pacification Commissions to train troops and serve as reserve officers. Now they are uniformly given liquor-monopoly posts—what was selected is not what is used, and what is used is not what was studied.

sentences.zh: 請取近歲中選人數，量其材品、考任，授以軍職，使之習練邊事，諳曉軍旅，實選用之初意也。」

translations.literal: Please take the number of those selected in recent years, assess their talent and rank, and assign them military posts, so that they may practice frontier affairs and become versed in military affairs—this truly accords with the original intent of selection and appointment."
translations.idiomatic: Please take recent qualifiers, assess talent and rank, and assign military posts so they may train in frontier affairs and master military affairs—in accord with the original intent of selection."

sentences.zh: 乾道二年，中書舍人蔣芾亦以為言，請以武舉登第者悉處之軍中。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qiandao, Secretariat Drafter Jiang Fu also spoke on this matter, requesting that all who passed the military examination be placed in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao 2, Secretariat Drafter Jiang Fu made the same proposal: all military examination graduates should be placed in the army.

sentences.zh: 帝以問洪適，適對曰：「武舉人以文墨進，雜於卒伍非便也。」

translations.literal: The emperor asked Hong Shi, who replied: "Military examination candidates advance through literary skill—mixing them among common soldiers is inconvenient."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Hong Shi, who replied: "Military examinees rise through literary skill—it is awkward to mix them among common soldiers."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「累經任者，可以將佐處之。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Those with repeated appointments may be placed as commanders and aides."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Those with repeated service may be placed as commanders and aides."

sentences.zh: 是歲，以登極推恩，武舉進士比文科正奏名例，第一名升一秩為成忠郎，第二、第三名依第一名恩例。

translations.literal: That year, upon accession grace, military jinshi were compared to the literary regular presented-name precedent: the first place was promoted one rank to Chenzhong Lang; second and third places received the first-place grace.
translations.idiomatic: That year, accession grace treated military jinshi like literary regular presented names: first place rose one rank to Chenzhong Lang; second and third received first-place benefits.

sentences.zh: 五年，兵部請外舍有校定人，參考榜上等者，候滿一年，私試四入等及不犯三等以上罰，或有校定而參考在中下等，候再試參考入中等，聽升補外舍生，赴公試。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Ministry of War requested that in the outer hall, those with ranked standing whose cross-reference sheet showed upper grade, after one full year with four private examination grades and no third-grade-or-above penalties, or those ranked but cross-referenced at middle-lower grade who upon re-examination reached middle grade, be permitted to advance and supplement as outer-hall students and proceed to the public examination.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5, the Ministry of War requested that outer-hall students with ranked standing and upper cross-reference grades, after one year with four passing private exams and no third-grade-or-higher penalties—or those at middle-lower cross-reference who reached middle grade on re-exam—be allowed to advance to outer-hall status and sit the public exam.

sentences.zh: 舊，除射親許試五等弓外，步射、馬射止許試第三等以下弓，程文雖優而參考弓馬分數難以對入優等；

translations.literal: Formerly, except that archery attendants were permitted to test five bow grades, foot and mounted archery were permitted only third grade and below; though policy essays were excellent, bow and horse scores were hard to match to upper grade;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, only archery attendants could test all five bow grades; foot and mounted archery were limited to the third grade and below, so even excellent policy essays could not always yield upper grades when cross-referenced with bow and horse scores;

sentences.zh: 自今許比上舍法，不以馬、步、射親，並通試五等。

translations.literal: from now on it was permitted to follow the upper-hall method: regardless of mounted, foot, or attendant archery, all could test five grades.
translations.idiomatic: henceforth the upper-hall rule applied: mounted, foot, and attendant archery alike could test all five grades.

sentences.zh: 吏部言：「武舉比試、發解、省試三場，依條以策義考定等第，具字號，會封彌所，以武藝並策義參考。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel said: "For the military examination's three stages—preliminary test, credential presentation, and provincial examination—regulations require grading policy questions, assigning numbers, meeting at the sealed-examination office, and cross-referencing martial arts with policy.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel reported: "In the military exam's three stages—preliminary, credential, and provincial—regulations require policy grading, numbered papers, sealed-examination review, and cross-reference of martial arts with policy answers.

sentences.zh: 今比試自依舊法，其解、省兩場，請依文士例，考定字號，先具奏聞，拆號放榜。」

translations.literal: The preliminary test shall follow the old method; for the credential and provincial stages, it is requested to follow the literary student precedent—grade and assign numbers, report first to the throne, then unseal and publish the list."
translations.idiomatic: The preliminary stage should follow the old rule; for credential and provincial stages, they asked to follow literary practice—grade and number papers, report to the throne, then unseal and publish results."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 初命武學生該遇登極覃恩，曾升補內舍或在學及五年曾經公、私試中人，並令赴省。

translations.literal: Initially, Military Academy students meeting accession universal grace—those who had been promoted to the inner hall, or who had been enrolled five years and passed public or private examinations—were all ordered to proceed to the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, Military Academy students eligible for accession universal grace—those promoted to the inner hall or enrolled five years with a public or private exam pass—were all sent to the provincial exam.

sentences.zh: 是歲廷試，始依文科給黃牒，榜首賜武舉及第，餘並賜武舉出身。

translations.literal: That year at the palace examination, yellow diplomas were first issued per the literary model; the top name was granted Military Examination Jinshi, and the rest were all granted Military Examination Background.
translations.idiomatic: That year's palace exam first issued yellow diplomas on the literary model: the top name received Military Examination Jinshi; all others received Military Examination Background.

sentences.zh: 其年，頒武舉之法。

translations.literal: That year, the law on the military examination was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: That year the military examination law was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 令四川帥臣、憲、漕、知州軍監及寄居侍從以上各舉武士一員，興元府、利閬金洋階成西和鳳州各三員，拔其尤者送四川安撫司，解試類省，並如文科。

translations.literal: It was ordered that Sichuan commanders, censors, transport officials, prefects, military commissioners, and resident attendant-ranked officials and above each recommend one warrior; Xingyuan Prefecture, Lizhou, Jinzhou, Yangzhou, Jiezhou, Chengzhou, Xihe, and Fengzhou three each; the best were sent to the Sichuan Pacification Commission for credential and provincial-style examinations, all following the literary model.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan commanders, censors, transport officials, prefects, military commissioners, and resident attendants and above were each to recommend one warrior; Xingyuan, Lizhou, Jin, Yang, Jie, Cheng, Xihe, and Feng three each. The best were sent to the Sichuan Pacification Commission for credential and provincial-style exams on the literary model.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年，議者請：「武學外舍生有校定公試合格，令試五等弓馬，與程文五等相參，入中上等者，據闕升補，餘俟再試入等升補。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Chunxi, petitioners requested: "For Military Academy outer-hall students with ranked standing and passing public examinations, let them test five bow and horse grades cross-referenced with five policy grades; those reaching middle-upper grade shall be promoted according to vacancies; the rest await re-examination and grade entry for promotion."
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 1, petitioners asked: "For outer-hall students with ranked standing and passing public exams, let them test five bow-and-horse grades cross-referenced with five policy grades; middle-upper ranks would fill vacancies for promotion, and others would wait for re-exam promotion."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 帝御幄殿，引見正奏名，呈試武藝。

translations.literal: The emperor at Canopy Hall received regular presented names and displayed martial arts.
translations.idiomatic: At Canopy Hall the emperor received regular presented names and reviewed their martial arts.

sentences.zh: 二年，以武科授官與文士不類，詔自今第一人補秉義郎，堂除諸司計議官，序位在機宜之上；

translations.literal: In the second year, because military appointments differed from literary ones, an edict ordered that from now on the first place be appointed Bingyi Lang, with direct appointment as planning officer of various bureaus, ranking above staff officers;
translations.idiomatic: In year 2, because military appointments differed from literary ones, an edict made first place Bingyi Lang with direct appointment as a bureau planning officer, ranking above staff officers;

sentences.zh: 第二、第三人保義郎，諸路帥司準備將領，代還，轉忠翊郎；

translations.literal: second and third places Baoyi Lang, reserve commanders under circuit commands, upon rotation Chengyi Lang;
translations.idiomatic: second and third Baoyi Lang as circuit reserve commanders, rotating to Chengyi Lang;

sentences.zh: 第四、第五人承節郎，諸路兵馬監押，代還，轉保義郎：皆仿進士甲科恩例。

translations.literal: fourth and fifth places Chengjie Lang, circuit troop supervisors, upon rotation Baoyi Lang—all following the jinshi top-grade grace precedent.
translations.idiomatic: fourth and fifth Chengjie Lang as circuit troop supervisors, rotating to Baoyi Lang—all on the jinshi top-grade model.

sentences.zh: 四年，以文科狀元代還，例除館職，亦召武舉榜首為閣門舍人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, as literary top graduates upon rotation were by precedent appointed to academy posts, the top name of the military examination was also summoned as Gate Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4, just as literary top graduates on rotation received academy posts, the military exam top name was also summoned as Gate Attendant.

sentences.zh: 五年，始立武學國子額，收補武臣親屬；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Military Academy Imperial student quota was first established, enrolling relatives of military officials;
translations.idiomatic: In year 5, a Military Academy Imperial-student quota was established for relatives of military officials;

sentences.zh: 其文臣親屬，願附補者亦聽。

translations.literal: relatives of civil officials who wished attached supplementation were also permitted.
translations.idiomatic: relatives of civil officials who wished attached entry were also allowed.

sentences.zh: 七年，初立《武舉絕倫並從軍法》：凡願從軍者，殿試第一人與同正將，第二、第三名同副將，五名以上、省試第一名、六名以下並同準備將；

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the Law on Exceptional Military Examination Talent and Military Service was first established: for all who wished to enter military service, the palace examination first place received the same rank as Regular General; second and third the same as Deputy General; five places or above, provincial first place, or six places and below all received the same as Reserve Commander;
