translations.idiomatic: In year 7, the Exceptional Military Talent and Military Service Law was enacted: volunteers received palace first place as Regular General, second and third as Deputy General, and five or more places, provincial first, or six or fewer as Reserve Commander;

sentences.zh: 從軍以後，立軍功及人材出眾者，特旨擢用。

translations.literal: after entering service, those who established military merit or whose talent was outstanding were specially promoted by imperial decree.
translations.idiomatic: after service, those with military merit or outstanding talent received special imperial promotion.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「武舉本求將帥之材，今前名皆從軍，以七年為限，則久在軍中，諳練軍政，他日可備委任。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The military examination originally seeks commander talent. Now the top names all enter military service; with a seven-year limit, long service in the army will master military affairs, and they may be entrusted with appointment hereafter."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The military exam exists to find commanders. Now top names all serve in the army; a seven-year term will let them master military affairs and become fit for future appointment."

sentences.zh: 八年，命特奏名補官，展減磨勘有差。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, special presented names were appointed to office, with varying extensions or reductions of merit review.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8, special presented names were appointed with varying merit-review extensions or reductions.

sentences.zh: 九年，議者以為從軍之人，率多養望，不屑軍旅。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, commentators held that those in military service mostly nursed reputation and disdained camp life.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, commentators said military servicemen mostly sought easy prestige and disdained camp duty.

sentences.zh: 詔自今職事勤恪者，從主帥保奏升差，懈惰者按劾。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that from now on those diligent in duty be promoted on commander recommendation, and the slack be investigated.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that henceforth the diligent be promoted on commander recommendation and the slack investigated.

sentences.zh: 光宗紹熙元年，武臣試換文資，南渡以前許從官三人薦舉，紹興令敦武郎以下聽召保官二人，以經義、詩賦求試，其後太學諸生久不第者，多去從武舉，已乃鎖廳應進士第。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxi under Emperor Guangzong, military officials testing to exchange for civil credentials: before the southward migration three attendant officials were permitted to recommend; under Shaoxing, Dunwu Lang and below were permitted two guarantor officials, testing in classics exegesis and regulated verse; later, Imperial Academy students who long failed to graduate mostly turned to the military examination and then took the locked-hall jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangzong's Shaoxi 1, military officials could test to exchange for civil credentials: before the southward migration three attendants could recommend; under Shaoxing, Dunwu Lang and below needed two guarantors and tested in classics and poetry. Later, long-failing Imperial Academy students often took the military exam, then the locked-hall jinshi exam.

sentences.zh: 凡以秉義或忠翊皆換京秩，恩數與第一人等。

translations.literal: All who received Bingyi or Chengyi exchanged to capital rank, with grace equal to first place.
translations.idiomatic: All who passed with Bingyi or Chengyi exchanged to capital rank with first-place benefits.

sentences.zh: 後以林穎秀言：「武士舍棄弓矢，更習程文，褒衣大袖，專做舉子。

translations.literal: Later, on Lin Yingxiu's words: "Warriors abandon bow and arrow and instead study examination essays, wearing robes and wide sleeves and devoting themselves solely to being examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: Later, citing Lin Yingxiu: "Warriors abandon bow and arrow to study examination essays, don robes and wide sleeves, and devote themselves to being examination candidates.

sentences.zh: 夫科以武名，不得雄健喜功之士，徒啟其僥幸名爵之心。」

translations.literal: A course named for martial arts gains no bold warriors eager for merit—it only kindles opportunist hearts for fame and rank."
translations.idiomatic: An exam named for martial arts attracts no bold warriors eager for merit—it only feeds opportunist hunger for fame and rank."

sentences.zh: 於是詔罷鎖廳換試。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict abolished the locked-hall exchange examination.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then abolished the locked-hall exchange exam.

sentences.zh: 寧宗即位，復其制，慶元五年，命兩淮、京西、湖北諸郡仿兵部及四川法，於本道安撫司試武士，合格者，赴行在解試，別立字號，分項考校，撥十名為解額，五名省額。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ningzong acceded, the system was restored. In the fifth year of Qingyuan, the Two Huai, Jingxi, and Hubei prefectures were ordered to follow the Ministry of War and Sichuan methods, testing warriors at their circuit pacification commissions; qualifiers proceeded to the capital for credential examination, with separate numbers, itemized grading, ten allotted as credential quota and five as provincial quota.
translations.idiomatic: When Ningzong acceded, the system was restored. In Qingyuan 5, Two Huai, Jingxi, and Hubei prefectures were ordered to test warriors at circuit pacification commissions on the Ministry and Sichuan model; qualifiers went to the capital for credential exams with separate numbers and itemized grading—ten credential slots and five provincial slots.

sentences.zh: 理宗紹定元年，命武舉進士避親及所舉之人止避本廳，令無妨嫌官引試，若合格，則朝廷別遣官復試。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoding under Emperor Lizong, it was ordered that military jinshi kin avoidance and those they recommended avoid only their own hall; impartial officials were to conduct the examination, and if qualified, the court would separately dispatch an official for re-examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Lizong's Shaoding 1, military jinshi kin-avoidance and recommended candidates needed avoid only their own hall; impartial officials would examine them, and if they passed, the court would send a separate official to re-examine them.

sentences.zh: 淳祐九年，以北兵屢至，命極邊、次邊一體收試，仍量增解額五名、省額二名。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Chunyou, because northern enemies arrived repeatedly, frontier and sub-frontier regions were ordered to recruit candidates together, with credential quota increased by five and provincial quota by two.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunyou 9, with repeated northern incursions, frontier and sub-frontier regions were ordered to recruit together, with credential quota raised by five and provincial quota by two.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武舉正奏名王時發已係從軍之人，充殿前司左軍統領，既登第，換授，特命就本職上與帶「同」字，以示優厚勸獎。

translations.literal: That year, the regular presented name Wang Shifa was already in military service as Commander-in-chief of the Left Army of the Palace Command; upon graduating and receiving a new appointment, he was specially ordered to retain his current post with the prefix "Tong" as a mark of generous encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: That year, regular presented name Wang Shifa was already serving as Left Army Commander-in-chief of the Palace Command; upon graduation and reassignment, he was specially allowed to keep his post with the prefix "Tong" as a generous reward.

sentences.zh: 度宗咸淳六年，命禮部貢院於武舉進士平等每百人內，取放待補十人，絕倫每百人內，取待補十三人。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xianchun under Emperor Duzong, the Ministry of Rites Examination Hall was ordered that among military jinshi of middle grade, ten awaiting appointment be taken per hundred; among exceptional talent, thirteen awaiting appointment per hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In Duzong's Xianchun 6, the Ministry of Rites Examination Hall was ordered to take ten awaiting-appointment middle-grade military jinshi per hundred and thirteen exceptional candidates per hundred.

sentences.zh: 算學。

translations.literal: Mathematics Learning.
translations.idiomatic: Mathematics Learning.

sentences.zh: 崇寧三年始建學，生員以二百一十人為額，許命官及庶人為之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongning the school was first established, with a student quota of two hundred ten; appointed officials and commoners were permitted to enroll.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongning 3 the school was established with a quota of 210 students, open to appointed officials and commoners.

sentences.zh: 其業以《九章》、《周髀》及假設疑數為算問，仍兼《海島》、《孫子》、《五曹》、張丘建夏侯陽算法並曆算、三式、天文書為本科。

translations.literal: The curriculum used the Nine Chapters, Zhou Bi, and hypothetical doubtful numbers for calculation questions, and also included the Sea Island, Sunzi, Five Departments, Zhang Qiujian, and Xiahou Yang algorithms together with calendrical calculation, Three Patterns, and astronomical texts as the core course.
translations.idiomatic: The curriculum used the Nine Chapters, Zhou Bi, and hypothetical problems for calculation questions, plus Sea Island, Sunzi, Five Departments, Zhang Qiujian, and Xiahou Yang algorithms along with calendrical calculation, Three Patterns, and astronomical texts as core subjects.

sentences.zh: 本科外，人占一小經，願占大經者聽。

translations.literal: Beyond the core course, each person selected one minor classic; those wishing a major classic were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the core, each student chose one minor classic; major classics were optional.

sentences.zh: 公私試、三舍法略如太學。

translations.literal: Public and private examinations and the three-hall method were roughly like the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Public and private exams and the three-hall system followed the Imperial Academy model.

sentences.zh: 上舍三等推恩，以通仕、登仕、將仕郎為次。

translations.literal: Upper-hall three-grade grace grants ranked Tongshi Lang, Dengshi Lang, and Jiangshi Lang in order.
translations.idiomatic: Upper-hall three-tier grace grants ranked Tongshi, Dengshi, and Jiangshi Lang in order.

sentences.zh: 大觀四年，以算學生歸之太史局，並書學生入翰林書藝局，畫學生入翰林圖畫局，醫學生入太醫局。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Daguan, mathematics students were assigned to the Astronomical Bureau; calligraphy students entered the Hanlin Calligraphy Bureau; painting students entered the Hanlin Painting Bureau; and medicine students entered the Imperial Medical Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Daguan 4, mathematics students went to the Astronomical Bureau; calligraphy students to the Hanlin Calligraphy Bureau; painting students to the Hanlin Painting Bureau; and medicine students to the Imperial Medical Bureau.

sentences.zh: 紹興初，命太史局試補，並募草澤人。

translations.literal: In early Shaoxing, the Astronomical Bureau was ordered to test for supplementation and also to recruit commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shaoxing, the Astronomical Bureau was ordered to test for supplementation and recruit commoners.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年春，聚局生子弟試曆算《崇天》、《宣明》、《大衍曆》三經，取其通習者。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Chunxi, children of bureau staff were gathered to test calendrical calculation on the three classics Chongtian, Xuanming, and Dayan Calendars, and those proficient were selected.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 1 spring, bureau staff's children were tested on calendrical calculation in the Chongtian, Xuanming, and Dayan Calendars; the proficient were selected.

sentences.zh: 五年，以《紀元曆》試。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, testing was on the Jiyuan Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5, testing used the Jiyuan Calendar.

sentences.zh: 九年，以《統元曆》試。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, testing was on the Tongyuan Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, testing used the Tongyuan Calendar.

sentences.zh: 十四年，用《崇天》、《紀元》、《統元曆》三歲一試。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, the Chongtian, Jiyuan, and Tongyuan Calendars were tested once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14, the Chongtian, Jiyuan, and Tongyuan Calendars were tested on a three-year cycle.

sentences.zh: 紹熙二年，命今歲春銓太史局試，應三全通、一粗通，合格者並特收取，時局生多闕故也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxi, it was ordered that in the spring of that year the Astronomical Bureau examination be held; those answering three fully proficient or one roughly proficient were all specially admitted, because bureau staff were then greatly lacking.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxi 2, a spring Astronomical Bureau exam was ordered; those with three fully proficient or one roughly proficient answers were all specially admitted because bureau staff were badly understrength.

sentences.zh: 嘉定四年，命局生必俟試中，方許轉補。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiading, bureau staff were required to pass the examination before transfer supplementation was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiading 4, bureau staff had to pass the exam before transfer supplementation.

sentences.zh: 理宗淳祐十二年，秘書省言：「舊典以太史局隸秘省，今引試局生不經秘書，非也。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Chunyou under Emperor Lizong, the Secretariat said: "The old rule placed the Astronomical Bureau under the Secretariat; now bureau staff examinations bypass the Secretariat—this is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: In Lizong's Chunyou 12, the Secretariat reported: "By old rule the Astronomical Bureau belonged to the Secretariat; bureau exams now bypass it—this is wrong.

sentences.zh: 稽之於令，諸局官應試曆算、天文、三式官，每歲附試，通等則以精熟為上，精熟等則以習他書多為上，習書等則以占事有驗為上。

translations.literal: Checking the regulations, for bureau officials testing in calendrical calculation, astronomy, and Three Patterns, there is an annual attached examination: among passes, mastery ranks highest; among equal mastery, more other books studied ranks highest; among equal book study, verified divination ranks highest.
translations.idiomatic: Checking regulations, bureau officials in calendrical calculation, astronomy, and Three Patterns took annual attached exams: among passes, mastery ranked first; equal mastery favored more auxiliary texts; equal texts favored verified divination.

sentences.zh: 諸局生補及二年以上者，並許就試。

translations.literal: All bureau staff supplemented two years or more were permitted to test.
translations.idiomatic: All bureau staff with two or more years of service could test.

sentences.zh: 一年試曆算一科，一年試天文、三式兩科，每科取一人。

translations.literal: One year tested calendrical calculation in one subject; one year tested astronomy and Three Patterns in two subjects; one person was taken per subject.
translations.idiomatic: One year tested calendrical calculation alone; another year astronomy and Three Patterns; one person was chosen per subject.

sentences.zh: 諸同知算造官闕有試，翰林天文官闕有試，諸靈台郎有應試補直長者，諸正名學生有試問《景祐新書》者，諸判局闕而合差，諸秤漏官五年而轉資者，無不屬於秘書；

translations.literal: Vacancies for Associate Calendar Compiler were filled by examination; Hanlin astronomer vacancies were filled by examination; Platform Attendants testing to supplement Chief Clerk; regular students questioned on the Jingyou New Treatise; bureau chief vacancies suitable for assignment; clepsydra officials rotating rank after five years—all fell under the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Associate Calendar Compiler vacancies, Hanlin astronomer vacancies, Platform Attendants testing for Chief Clerk, regular students questioned on the Jingyou New Treatise, bureau-chief vacancies for assignment, and clepsydra officials rotating after five years—all belonged to the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 而局官等人各置腳色，遇有差遣、改補、功過之類，並申秘書。

translations.literal: and bureau officials and others each kept personnel records; assignments, transfers, merits, and faults were all reported to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: and bureau officials kept personnel records; assignments, transfers, merits, and faults were all reported to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 今乃一切自行陳請，殊乖初意。

translations.literal: Now all petition on their own—greatly contrary to the original intent.
translations.idiomatic: Now they all petition independently—far from the original intent.

sentences.zh: 自今有違令補差，及不經秘書公試補中者，中書執奏改正，仍從舊制，申嚴試法。」

translations.literal: From now on, those violating appointment rules and those supplemented without passing the Secretariat public examination—the Central Secretariat shall report for correction; the old system shall be restored and examination rules strictly enforced."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, illegal appointments and supplementation without passing the Secretariat public exam would be reported by the Central Secretariat for correction; the old system would be restored and exam rules strictly enforced."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 書學生，習篆、隸、草三體，明《說文》、《字說》、《爾雅》、《博雅》、《方言》，兼通《論語》、《孟子》義，願占大經者聽。

translations.literal: Calligraphy students studied seal, clerical, and cursive scripts; mastered the Shuowen, Character Explanations, Erya, Boya, and Fangyan; and also understood the exegesis of the Analects and Mencius; those wishing a major classic were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Calligraphy students studied seal, clerical, and cursive scripts; mastered the Shuowen, Character Explanations, Erya, Boya, and Fangyan; and also passed Analects and Mencius exegesis; major classics were optional.

sentences.zh: 篆以古文、大小二篆為法，隸以二王、歐、虞、顏、柳真行為法，草以章草、張芝九體為法。

translations.literal: For seal script, ancient script and large and small seal scripts were the models; for clerical script, the Two Wangs, Ouyang, Yu, Yan, and Liu in regular and running script were the models; for cursive script, draft cursive and Zhang Zhi's nine forms were the models.
translations.idiomatic: Seal script followed ancient and large/small seal models; clerical script the Two Wangs, Ouyang, Yu, Yan, and Liu in regular and running script; cursive draft cursive and Zhang Zhi's nine forms.

sentences.zh: 考書之等，以方圓肥瘦適中，鋒藏畫勁，氣清韻古，老而不俗為上；

translations.literal: In grading calligraphy, balanced square and round and fat and thin, hidden tip and vigorous strokes, clear spirit and ancient resonance, aged yet not vulgar ranked upper;
translations.idiomatic: Calligraphy was graded upper for balanced square and round and fat and thin, hidden tip and vigorous stroke, clear spirit and ancient resonance, aged yet not vulgar;

sentences.zh: 方而有圓筆，圓而有方意，瘦而不枯，肥而不濁，各得一體者為中；

translations.literal: square with round brushwork, round with square intent, thin without withering, fat without muddiness, each achieving one style ranked middle;
translations.idiomatic: middle for square with round brushwork, round with square intent, thin without withering, fat without muddiness, each achieving one style;

sentences.zh: 方而不能圓，肥而不能瘦，模仿古人筆畫不得其意，而均齊可觀為下。

translations.literal: square without round, fat without thin, imitating ancient brushwork without grasping intent yet evenly presentable ranked lower.
translations.idiomatic: lower for square without round, fat without thin, imitating ancients without grasping intent yet evenly presentable.

sentences.zh: 其三舍補試升降略同算學法，惟推恩降一等。

translations.literal: Its three-hall supplementation, examination, promotion, and demotion were roughly like the mathematics method, except grace grants were one grade lower.
translations.idiomatic: Three-hall supplementation, exams, and promotion followed the mathematics model, but grace grants were one grade lower.

sentences.zh: 自初置及並罷年數，悉同算學。

translations.literal: From initial establishment through abolition, the number of years was entirely the same as mathematics.
translations.idiomatic: From establishment through abolition, its timeline matched mathematics exactly.

sentences.zh: 畫學之業，曰佛道，曰人物，曰山水，曰鳥獸，曰花竹，曰屋木，以《說文》、《爾雅》、《方言》、《釋名》教授。

translations.literal: The painting curriculum comprised Buddhist and Taoist subjects, figures, landscape, birds and beasts, flowers and bamboo, and architecture; instruction used the Shuowen, Erya, Fangyan, and Shiming.
translations.idiomatic: Painting covered Buddhist/Taoist subjects, figures, landscape, birds and beasts, flowers and bamboo, and architecture, taught with the Shuowen, Erya, Fangyan, and Shiming.

sentences.zh: 《說文》則令書篆字，著音訓，餘書皆設問答，以所解義觀其能通畫意與否。

translations.literal: For the Shuowen, students were made to write seal characters with phonetic glosses; for the other texts question-and-answer was set up to observe whether they could grasp painting intent.
translations.idiomatic: Shuowen required writing seal characters with phonetic glosses; other texts used Q&A to test grasp of painting intent.

sentences.zh: 仍分士流、雜流，別其齋以居之。

translations.literal: They were still divided into gentry and common streams, with separate dormitories for residence.
translations.idiomatic: Students were divided into gentry and common streams with separate dormitories.

sentences.zh: 士流兼習一大經或一小經，雜流則誦小經或讀律。

translations.literal: The gentry stream also studied one major classic or one minor classic; the common stream recited a minor classic or read law.
translations.idiomatic: Gentry students also studied one major or minor classic; common students recited a minor classic or read law.

sentences.zh: 考畫之等，以不仿前人而物之情態形色俱若自然，筆韻高簡為工。

translations.literal: In grading painting, not imitating predecessors yet with forms and colors all as if natural, and brush resonance lofty and concise, ranked as excellent work.
translations.idiomatic: Painting was graded excellent when forms and colors seemed natural without imitating predecessors and brushwork was lofty and concise.

sentences.zh: 三舍試補、升降以及推恩如前法。

translations.literal: Three-hall testing, supplementation, promotion, demotion, and grace grants followed the previous method.
translations.idiomatic: Three-hall testing, supplementation, promotion, and grace followed the earlier method.

sentences.zh: 惟雜流授官，止自三班借職以下三等。

translations.literal: Only for the common stream, office appointment stopped at three grades below Third Rank Provisional.
translations.idiomatic: Common-stream appointments stopped at three grades below Third Rank Provisional.

sentences.zh: 醫學，初隸太常寺，神宗時始置提舉判局官及教授一人，學生三百人。

translations.literal: Medicine Learning was initially subordinate to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; in Emperor Shenzong's time a Supervising Bureau Chief and one Instructor were first established, with three hundred students.
translations.idiomatic: Medicine Learning initially belonged to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; under Shenzong a Supervising Bureau Chief and one Instructor were first appointed, with 300 students.

sentences.zh: 設三科以教之，曰方脈科、針科、瘍科。

translations.literal: Three departments were established to teach them, called Internal Medicine, Acupuncture, and Surgery.
translations.idiomatic: Three departments were established: Internal Medicine, Acupuncture, and Surgery.

sentences.zh: 凡方脈以《素問》、《難經》、《脈經》為大經，以《巢氏病源》、《龍樹論》、《千金翼方》為小經，針、瘍科則去《脈經》而增《三部針灸經》。

translations.literal: For Internal Medicine, the Suwen, Nanjing, and Maijing were major classics; the Chao Clan Pathogenesis, Nagarjuna Treatise, and Thousand Gold Formulary Supplement were minor classics; for Acupuncture and Surgery, the Maijing was removed and the Three-Part Acupuncture-Moxibustion Classic was added.
translations.idiomatic: Internal Medicine took the Suwen, Nanjing, and Maijing as major classics and the Chao Clan Pathogenesis, Nagarjuna Treatise, and Thousand Gold Formulary Supplement as minor classics; Acupuncture and Surgery dropped the Maijing and added the Three-Part Acupuncture-Moxibustion Classic.

sentences.zh: 常以春試，三學生願與者聽。

translations.literal: Examinations were regularly held in spring; students of the three schools who wished to participate were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Examinations were regularly held each spring; students of the three medical schools who wished to participate were allowed to do so.

sentences.zh: 崇寧間，改隸國子監，置博士、正、錄各四員，分科教導，糾行規矩。

translations.literal: During the Chongning period it was transferred to the Directorate of Education; four erudites, four directors, and four recorders were established to teach by specialty and enforce conduct and rules.
translations.idiomatic: During Chongning it was placed under the Directorate of Education, with four erudites, four directors, and four recorders appointed to teach by specialty and enforce discipline.

sentences.zh: 立上舍四十人，內舍六十，外舍二百，齋各置長諭一人。

translations.literal: Forty upper-hall, sixty inner-hall, and two hundred outer-hall places were established; each hall had one chief instructor.
translations.idiomatic: Enrollment was set at forty upper-hall, sixty inner-hall, and two hundred outer-hall students; each hall had one chief instructor.

sentences.zh: 其考試：第一場問三經大義五道；

translations.literal: The examinations: the first session asked five questions on the broad meaning of the three classics;
translations.idiomatic: The examinations were structured as follows: the first session posed five questions on the broad meaning of the three classics;

sentences.zh: 次場方脈試脈證、運氣大義各二道，針、瘍試小經大義三道，運氣大義二道；

translations.literal: the second session for internal medicine tested two questions each on pulse diagnosis and the broad meaning of seasonal qi; for acupuncture and surgery, three questions on the minor classics and two on seasonal qi;
translations.idiomatic: the second session for internal medicine tested two questions each on pulse patterns and seasonal qi; for acupuncture and surgery, three questions on the minor classics and two on seasonal qi;

sentences.zh: 三場假令治病法三道。

translations.literal: the third session posed three hypothetical cases on methods of treatment.
translations.idiomatic: the third session posed three hypothetical cases on treatment methods.

sentences.zh: 中格高等，為尚藥局醫師以下職，餘各以等補官，為本學博士、正、錄及外州醫學教授。

translations.literal: Those who passed at the upper grade received posts from Imperial Pharmacy physicians downward; the rest were appointed by grade as erudites, directors, and recorders of this school and as medical instructors in outer prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Those who passed at the upper grade were appointed to posts from Imperial Pharmacy physician downward; the rest received appointments by grade as instructors at the school or as medical professors in other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 紹興中，復置醫學，以醫師主之。

translations.literal: During the Shaoxing period medical studies were restored, directed by a chief physician.
translations.idiomatic: During Shaoxing, medical studies were restored under the direction of a chief physician.

sentences.zh: 翰林局醫生並奏試人，並試經義一十二道，取六通為合格。

translations.literal: Hanlin Bureau medical students and memorial-test candidates alike were examined on twelve questions of classic meaning, with six passes required for qualification.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Bureau medical students and memorial-test candidates alike faced twelve questions on classic meaning, with six correct answers required to qualify.

sentences.zh: 乾道三年，罷局而存禦醫諸科，後更不置局而存留醫學科，令每舉附省闈別試所解發，太常寺掌行其事。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qiandao the bureau was abolished but the various imperial-physician categories retained; later the bureau was not re-established but the medical subject remained, ordered each cycle to attach to the separate examination compound of the provincial gate for recommendation and dispatch, with the Court of Imperial Sacrifices administering it.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao 3 the bureau was abolished but imperial-physician categories were retained. Later the bureau was not restored, but the medical subject remained, attached each cycle to the provincial examination's separate medical compound for recommendations, administered by the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十五年，命內外白身醫士，經禮部先附銓闈，試脈義一場三道，取其二通者赴次年省試，經義三場一十二道，以五通為合格，五取其一補醫生，俟再赴省試升補，八通翰林醫學，六通祗候，其特補、薦補並停。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Chunxi, commoner physicians inside and outside the capital were ordered to attach first to the selection examination compound through the Ministry of Rites and sit one session of three pulse-meaning questions; those passing two proceeded to the provincial examination the next year—three sessions of twelve classic-meaning questions, five passes qualifying, one selected from every five to replenish medical students, and after a second provincial examination advancement: eight passes for Hanlin medical studies, six for attendant service; special replenishment and recommendation replenishment were both stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 15, commoner physicians throughout the realm were required to enter first through the Ministry of Rites selection compound and pass two of three pulse-meaning questions. Successful candidates then sat the provincial examination the following year—three sessions totaling twelve classic-meaning questions, with five passes required. One in five who qualified was appointed a medical student; after a second provincial examination, eight passes qualified for Hanlin medical studies and six for attendant service. Special and recommended replenishment were both abolished.

sentences.zh: 紹熙二年，復置太醫局，銓試依舊格。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxi the Imperial Medical Bureau was restored, and selection examinations followed the old standards.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxi 2 the Imperial Medical Bureau was restored, with selection examinations following the former standards.

sentences.zh: 其省試三場，以第一場定去留，墨義、大義等題仿此。

translations.literal: Its three provincial sessions used the first session to determine pass or fail; written interpretation, broad meaning, and similar topics followed this rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the three-session provincial examination, the first session determined pass or fail; written interpretation, broad meaning, and similar topics followed the same principle.

sentences.zh: 補道職，舊無試，元豐三年始差官考試，以《道德經》、《靈寶度人經》、《南華真經》等命題，仍試齋醮科儀祝讀。

translations.literal: Replenishment of Daoist posts formerly had no examination; in the third year of Yuanfeng officials were first dispatched to conduct examinations, setting questions from the 《Classic of the Way and Its Power》, the 《Lingbao Salvation Scripture》, the 《True Classic of Southern Florescence》, and the like, and also testing liturgical recitation for fasting and offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Replenishment of Daoist posts had formerly required no examination. In the third year of Yuanfeng officials were first dispatched to examine candidates, with questions drawn from the 《Classic of the Way and Its Power》, the 《Lingbao Salvation Scripture》, the 《True Classic of Southern Florescence》, and similar texts, and with tests of liturgical recitation for fasting and offerings.

sentences.zh: 政和間，即州、縣學別置齋授道徒。

translations.literal: During the Zhenghe period, separate halls were established at prefectural and county schools to instruct Daoist disciples.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhenghe, separate halls were established at prefectural and county schools to instruct Daoist disciples.

sentences.zh: 蔡攸上《諸州選試道職法》，其業以《黃帝內經》、《道德經》為大經，《莊子》、《列子》為小經。

translations.literal: Cai You submitted the 《Methods for Selecting and Testing Daoist Posts in the Prefectures》; the curriculum took the 《Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic》 and the 《Classic of the Way and Its Power》 as major classics and the 《Zhuangzi》 and 《Liezi》 as minor classics.
translations.idiomatic: Cai You submitted the 《Methods for Selecting and Testing Daoist Posts in the Prefectures》. The curriculum designated the 《Yellow Emperor's Inner Classic》 and the 《Classic of the Way and Its Power》 as major classics and the 《Zhuangzi》 and 《Liezi》 as minor classics.

sentences.zh: 提學司訪求精通道經者，不問已命、未仕，皆審驗以聞。

translations.literal: School intendants were to seek out those thoroughly versed in the Daoist canon, whether already appointed or not yet in office, verify them, and report upward.
translations.idiomatic: School intendants were to seek out those thoroughly versed in the Daoist canon, whether already appointed or not yet serving, verify their credentials, and report to the throne.

sentences.zh: 其業儒而能慕從道教者聽。

translations.literal: Those trained in Confucian learning who wished to follow the Daoist teaching were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Confucian scholars who wished to follow the Daoist teaching were also permitted to enroll.

sentences.zh: 每路於見任官內，選有學術者二人為幹官，分詣諸州檢察教習。

translations.literal: Each circuit selected two learned incumbent officials as executive officers to visit the various prefectures and inspect instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Each circuit selected two learned incumbent officials as executive officers to visit the prefectures and inspect instruction.

sentences.zh: 《內經》、《道德經》置博士，《聖濟經》兼講。

translations.literal: Erudites were established for the 《Inner Classic》 and the 《Classic of the Way and Its Power》, with the 《Classic of Sagely Aid》 also lectured.
translations.idiomatic: Erudites were appointed for the 《Inner Classic》 and the 《Classic of the Way and Its Power》, with the 《Classic of Sagely Aid》 also included in the curriculum.

sentences.zh: 道徒升貢，悉如文士。

translations.literal: Daoist disciples advancing to presentation followed literary scholars entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Daoist disciples advancing to presentation followed the same procedures as literary scholars.

sentences.zh: 初入官，補志士道職，賜褐服，藝能高出其徒者，得推恩。

translations.literal: On first entering office they were replenished as aspirant Daoist posts, granted brown robes, and those whose arts surpassed their fellows could receive conferred favor.
translations.idiomatic: On first entering office they were appointed to aspirant Daoist posts and granted brown robes; those whose accomplishment surpassed their fellows could receive conferred favor.

sentences.zh: 道徒術業精退，州守貳有考課殿最罪法。

translations.literal: When Daoist disciples' arts declined in refinement, prefects and vice prefects had regulations for examination grading of achievement and penalties.
translations.idiomatic: When Daoist disciples' skills declined, prefects and vice prefects were authorized to grade their performance and impose penalties under established regulations.

sentences.zh: 陳州學生慕從道教，逾月而道徒換籍，殆與儒生相半。

translations.literal: Students of Chenzhou admired and followed the Daoist teaching; within a month Daoist disciples changed registers, nearly half matching Confucian students.
translations.idiomatic: Students in Chen Prefecture flocked to the Daoist teaching; within a month so many had changed their registration to Daoist status that Daoist disciples nearly equaled Confucian students in number.

sentences.zh: 有宋瑀者，願改道徒內舍，獻《神霄玉清萬壽宮雅》一篇，特換志士，俟殿試。

translations.literal: One Song Yu wished to change to inner-hall Daoist disciple status, presented one piece entitled 《Elegant Composition for the Jade Clarity Myriad Longevity Palace of the Divine Empyrean》, and was specially transferred to aspirant Daoist status to await the palace examination.
translations.idiomatic: A student named Song Yu asked to transfer to inner-hall Daoist status, presented an essay entitled 《Elegant Composition for the Jade Clarity Myriad Longevity Palace of the Divine Empyrean》, and was specially promoted to aspirant Daoist status pending the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 由是長倅以下受賞有差，其誘勸之重如此。

translations.literal: Thereupon the chief administrator and his subordinates received differentiated rewards—such was the weight placed on encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the chief administrator and his subordinates received differentiated rewards, showing how heavily such encouragement was weighted.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年，學罷。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuanhe the school was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 2 the school was abolished.
